title: CattoHub I Aimbot
features:
1. Smooth Aimbot with Target Lock

Unlike janky aimbots that snap instantly (obvious cheating), CattoHub smooths the aim
Target persistence system - once locked on, it stays on target even if they move
Customizable FOV circle so you control how aggressive it is
Only activates when holding right-click for natural gameplay

2. Smart Dead Detection System

Other scripts still highlight dead players, wasting your time
CattoHub uses advanced weapon-drop detection to instantly gray out dead enemies
No more shooting at corpses - saves ammo and reveals your position

3. Rainbow Chams ESP

Most scripts have static colored ESP that's boring and hard to see
CattoHub has smooth rainbow transitions that look amazing and are easier to spot
Works through walls so you always know where enemies are

4. Clean PlayStation UI

Most scripts have ugly, cluttered interfaces
CattoHub uses a sleek PlayStation-style menu that's easy to navigate
Everything organized into clear tabs (ESP, Aimbot, Misc)

5. Performance Optimized

Runs smoothly without FPS drops
Smart cleanup systems prevent memory leaks
Won't slow down your game like bloated scripts

6. Extra Features

Full Bright - See in dark areas clearly
No Clip - Walk through anything

Report bugs and get help
Suggest new features
Early access to updates
Meet other users
